values.note: Single site $40 per night (recreation.gov peak season 2026 and 2027 alike); additional vehicle $10 per vehicle per day (two vehicles per site, extras in the overflow lot). Group sites $100 (up to 25) or $115 (26-50) per night on the FS page.

values.note: Senior and Access passes give 50% off the pass holder's own single campsite only; enter the pass when booking.

values.note: Run by a concessionaire (American Land & Leisure; customer service 801-226-3564). Only about half the 99 single sites are on recreation.gov (46 bookable standard sites + 2 tent sites in the catalog); the campground also has first-come sites. A reserved site is yours: you may not move to another. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m.

values.note: 99 single family sites in four loops plus 3 group sites (tent camping only, up to 50 guests each). The 48 RV sites in the recreation.gov catalog are all back-in, listed maximum vehicle lengths 28-54 ft (most 34-44 ft); the rest of the single sites are not in the catalog.

note: Manistee NF campground on the Lake Michigan shore 15 mi south of Manistee (between Manistee and Ludington), along Porter Creek beside the Nordhouse Dunes Wilderness. Boardwalk/stairs to a sandy beach, overlook deck, amphitheater with peak-season programs, playground; the Arrowhead Trail loops between the campground and the beach and a Nordhouse Dunes trailhead is in the recreation area. 8 mi in from US-31 on Forest Trail Road (FS 5629). --Claude
